review.note: Completed detail embeds a bounded read-only report (version facts, caps, gap classes, evidence sufficiency with explicit unknown citations, stale advisory, actions) and job-target history exposes the same payloads without per-row reads. Existing RIP-013 assertions (low-score completed result, failed->result None, cursor semantics) remain green.

acceptance_mapping.RIP-014_6.1_report_projection: report_payload embeds exact version facts, pre/post-cap totals, 8 dimensions with weights, 4 gap classes, evidence sufficiency, policy/model metadata, explicit unknowns; never stored, never mutates the assessment
acceptance_mapping.RIP-014_6.3_actions_never_score_gated: low-score (reject) report keeps plan + interview actions eligible; resume_optimization only when the assessment's resume version is a builder draft
acceptance_mapping.RIP-014_7.1_no_N_plus_1: MatchReportQueries._build loads jd_version/resume_version/target/jd in one joined SELECT; history endpoint reuses MatchAssessmentQueries.list (limit+1 cursor) and embeds reports
acceptance_mapping.RIP-014_7.3_VERSION_STALE_advisory: stale flags jd_has_newer_published_version / target_default_*_moved vs current versions; assessment versions never replaced
acceptance_mapping.RIP-014_9_target_history_endpoint: GET /api/v1/job-targets/{id}/match-assessments cursor history with report on completed items; 404 for unknown target
acceptance_mapping.issue_AC_unknown_evidence: fake classifier cites fixed ids outside the Source Catalog; report marks them explicit_unknowns under evidence_citation
acceptance_mapping.issue_AC_legacy_match_separation: history only lists match_assessments of the target; legacy jd_match_results never conflated (empty-scope test)

gates.migration: not required (read-only projection; no schema change)

residual_risks: Report unknown-citation detection cross-checks cited ids against a deterministic re-derivation of the Source Catalog from the pinned versions; if the version snapshot format ever changes, the catalog re-derivation must stay in sync with build_catalog
Action routes are stable API path hints resolved by the UI; a route change in the frontend does not break the report contract
